name: Village Farm Camp
description_short: Camp NAC's farm day camp for ages 6 to 12 at a separate site in Langhorne, where campers meet animals, try archery, make nature crafts and play water games. Two days a week they swim at the Newtown Athletic Club's outdoor water park.
notes: Runs 9 to 3 and is booked by the week through Camp NAC, mixed with any other Camp NAC weeks. Rates are given only through a request form, so no price is listed. Camp office 215-944-8860, info@campnac.com.
